A Weekend in Porto

Porto is a hilly city in northern Portugal, famous for its riverside district, Ribeira, and its port wine cellars across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia.

The famous old bookshop near the university is popular, so book a ticket online to avoid long queues. The Dom Luís I bridge offers views over the old town.

The metro connects the airport to the city centre in about 30 minutes.

Comfortable shoes are essential, because many streets are steep and paved with cobblestones.
